title: Hub broadcast fans out a payload from client A to all connected clients within the elicited window
asA: developer coordinating multiplayer websocket clients through one authoritative hub
iWant: the HubObject to fan out a broadcast payload from one connected client to all connected clients within the elicited window
soThat: the shipped hub shape delivers the coordinated-multiplayer contract without a hand-rolled broadcast layer

acceptanceCriteria.description: A HubObject with two accepted fake websockets A and B, when driven with webSocketMessage(A, JSON.stringify({type:"broadcast", payload:"ping"})), delivers a JSON message to both A and B whose type is "broadcast" and payload is "ping" within 500ms elapsed on the fixture clock. The persisted lastBroadcast key in storage carries the serialised outbound payload.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a HubObject with two accepted fake websocket sockets
acceptanceCriteria.when: a broadcast message is sent from A
acceptanceCriteria.then: both A and B receive the same broadcast within 500ms and storage.get("lastBroadcast") returns the serialised payload

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-4 broadcast-malformed: webSocketMessage(A, "not-json-at-all") on a HubObject with two accepted sockets does NOT fan out anything; the hub replies to A with an error frame carrying {type:"error", kind:"HUB_MALFORMED_MESSAGE"} and B receives nothing. storage.get("lastBroadcast") stays at its prior value (or remains undefined on a fresh hub); no doBroadcast record emits.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a HubObject with two accepted fake sockets A and B
acceptanceCriteria.then: the hub sends A an error frame with kind HUB_MALFORMED_MESSAGE; B receives no message; lastBroadcast is unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.description: Empty-hub broadcast (zero connected clients): a HubObject with zero accepted sockets, when driven with an out-of-band broadcast API (state.broadcast) or an incoming HTTP fetch that carries a broadcast payload, still persists storage.lastBroadcast so a subsequent socket connect can catch up. No client message is emitted (nobody is listening); the persistence side effect is the only observable.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a HubObject with zero accepted sockets
acceptanceCriteria.when: a broadcast is driven through the hub API
acceptanceCriteria.then: no client message emits; storage.get("lastBroadcast") returns the serialised payload

acceptanceCriteria.description: Slow-socket isolation: a HubObject with three accepted sockets A, B and C where B's send() blocks (simulated by a promise that never settles), when driven with a broadcast from A, still delivers the broadcast to C within the elicited 500ms window. The hub does not await B; the slow socket is dropped from the broadcast fan-out for that message and a doBroadcastSocketSlow record emits naming the slow socket id.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a HubObject with three sockets where B blocks
acceptanceCriteria.then: C receives the broadcast within 500ms; a doBroadcastSocketSlow record names B's socket id

acceptanceCriteria.description: N=10 concurrent broadcasts: a HubObject with two accepted sockets A and B, driven with 10 concurrent broadcasts from A, delivers 10 messages to B in the same order A issued them. Per-connection ordering is preserved (10 messages in A-issue-order); storage.get("lastBroadcast") after the batch returns the 10th payload.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a HubObject with two accepted sockets
acceptanceCriteria.then: B receives 10 messages in issue order; lastBroadcast returns the 10th payload

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-4 hub-unknown-type: webSocketMessage(A, JSON.stringify({type:"nonsense"})) on a HubObject does NOT change storage; the hub replies to A with an error frame carrying {type:"error", kind:"HUB_UNKNOWN_MESSAGE_TYPE"} naming the unknown type; B receives nothing; storage.get("lastBroadcast") is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a HubObject with two accepted sockets
acceptanceCriteria.when: A sends a message whose type is not broadcast|set-state|get-state
acceptanceCriteria.then: A receives an HUB_UNKNOWN_MESSAGE_TYPE error frame; B receives nothing; storage is unchanged
